title: Iddoo Biqiltuu Yeroo Bari'u Dhaadate
intro: Sa'aatii tasgabbaa'aa osoo aduun hin ba'iin dura karoorri dhoksaan qophaa'e. Dhaalli dagaagaa taʼe tokko midhaan sassaabuuf qophaaʼee kan dhaabbate siʼa taʼu, firii hundumaa warra rakkatan irraa fageessuuf murtoon uumame. Ganama ganama wanti hundi waan hin baramne fakkaata, barumsi tokkos damee gurraacha’e irratti bocamee namoota yaadan hundaaf ta’a.
clues: Iddoo biqiltuu dagaagaa jiru dhaalnee firii isaa hunda ofii keenyaaf akka sassaabnu dhaadanne.
Hiyyeeyyiin qooda isaanii gaafatan ammallee hirriba keessa osoo jiranii barii dafnee ba'uuf kakanne.
Kakaa keenya keessaa ala ta’e kamiyyuu hambisnee yoo Rabbiin fedhe osoo hin jedhiin mirga rakkataa dhowwine.
Guyyaa sana namni hiyyeessi tokkollee akka maasii keenyatti hin seenne wal hasaasaa baane.
Waan hundumaa walitti qabuu fi namni sassaabamu kamiyyuu qooda akka hin fudhanne gochuuf dandeettii guutuu akka qabnu of yaadne.
Dammaqnee maasii keenya halkan diigamee, akka waan sassaabameetti gurraacha’ee, mulqannee gaabbii galchine jenne.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
